==Notes==
* This buff was received during [[The Frog]]'s visit in the [[Farewell to Gaile]] event.
*Anet has stated that this skill is unlikely to be used again, due to the strain on the servers when people took advantage of it.

==Trivia==
* The description is a variation of a famous quote from [[w:Wayne's_World|Wayne's World]]. The quote in reference is "[[wikiquote:Wayne%27s_World#Wayne_.26_Garth_catch-phrases|Wayne's World, Wayne's World, party time, excellent!]]"
*The skill type is a play on words.
